subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should this Discord media fix add public preserveWebp/preserveAvif SDK options and fail preserved over-cap media, or should the behavior stay behind a narrower Discord-owned seam with a documented cap policy?
rationale: Both remaining blockers affect public plugin contracts and user-visible media delivery semantics; automation cannot choose that permanent API and compatibility direction safely.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the fix in the Discord/shared-media owner boundary without unapproved public SDK options, add cap-behavior tests, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Approve the SDK expansion
options.body: Maintain the new public options only if maintainers want this as a third-party plugin contract and the PR adds matching docs, contract tests, and upgrade notes.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: If the conflicting source branch is too stale to safely update, open a narrow replacement PR that preserves contributor credit and carries over only the approved fix shape.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the fix in the Discord/shared-media owner boundary without unapproved public SDK options, add cap-behavior tests, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-boundary history in Discord send paths, plugin SDK documentation, and shared media behavior.
